insight: Founded by Stanford professors Kunle Olukotun and Chris Re; raised $676M at a $5.1B valuation led by SoftBank in 2021.
name: SambaNova Cloud
tagline: Fast inference for open models on custom RDU chips.
description: Inference cloud running open-weight models — Llama, DeepSeek, Qwen, gpt-oss — on SambaNova's RDU hardware at hundreds of tokens per second, including full-precision Llama 405B. Provides an OpenAI-compatible API with a free tier and pay-per-token pricing.

modelSupport.notes: Serves open-weight models on RDU hardware via an OpenAI-compatible API.

edge: One of the few clouds serving Llama 405B in native 16-bit precision at 100+ tokens/sec, not a quantized copy.
pros: Hundreds of tokens/sec on RDU chips
cons: No fine-tuning/custom hosting like GPU clouds
